signal_evidence.credit_quality_trend: Domestic card charge-off rate for the second quarter was 4.71% down 39 basis points from the prior quarter and down 54 basis points year over year. The delinquency rate was 3.39% at quarter end, down 31 basis points from the linked quarter.
signal_evidence.auto_credit_trend: The auto charge off rate for the quarter was 1.43%... down 21 basis points from the sequential quarter... The auto delinquency rate was... down 52 basis points from the prior year.
signal_evidence.capex_direction: We continue to invest in foundational technology, AI, and the longer term growth opportunities... total company marketing expense in the quarter was about $1.7 billion up 23% year over year.
signal_evidence.pricing_power: NIM of 8.01%, 14 basis points higher than the prior quarter... driven by a lower rate paid on retail deposits and a $5 billion decline in average cash balances.
signal_evidence.management_tone_shift: The US consumer and the overall economy remained resilient... when we look at bank balances and debt servicing burdens of our customers, these look a bit stronger than a year ago across income levels... we are leaning in with a lot of positivity into our growth strategies.
